description: Registry for live/browser-observed Design Guide bugs. A live bug is not considered fixed unless it has a focused verifier listed here and that verifier passes.

entries.description: Shear overdesign cleanup must not publish a family contract violation or a stale/no-op cleanup state after the contract-owned width cleanup or terminal proof has been evaluated.
entries.input_state: Live overdesign/cleanup path with low shear utilisation, geometry unlocked, and width-cleanup or exact-terminal publication evidence.
entries.expected_card_state: A valid optimisation action or accepted terminal card; never Design Guide family contract violation.
entries.expected_cta_state: Executable apply CTA when a safe cleanup exists, otherwise explicit terminal/no-cleanup proof.
entries.expected_target_or_blocker: Target band reached, smallest safe cleanup candidate, or explicit contract-defined no-further-cleanup blocker.
entries.source: Live app screenshots and browser checks from the shear cleanup width-publication issue.

entries.description: The model diagram must still render for current invalid input geometry, but Design Brain must not recommend or apply a candidate whose resulting depth-to-width ratio exceeds the family contract.
entries.scope: GEOMETRY_DETAILING_GOVERNS / shared Design Guide apply guard
entries.input_state: Current input geometry has D/b above the contract limit.
entries.expected_card_state: Geometry correction action or explicit blocker; model renderer does not hide the current diagram.
entries.expected_cta_state: Executable geometry correction only when the resulting candidate satisfies the contract ratio.
entries.expected_target_or_blocker: Candidate ratio must be <= the contract limit or blocked with depth_width_ratio_above_contract_limit.
entries.source: Live app screenshot showing model hidden for D/b > 2.0.

entries.description: A stale canonical primary payload must not block one-click when the current FinalDesignGuidePublication CTA has a fresh executor-backed apply payload.
entries.input_state: One-click finds a candidate but the old primary payload fingerprint is stale.
entries.expected_cta_state: Use the fresh FinalDesignGuidePublication.cta payload when available; only block stale payload when no fresh publication CTA exists.
entries.expected_target_or_blocker: Fresh CTA applies, or stale guard reports a real missing fresh payload.
entries.source: Live app yellow warning: One-click found a candidate, but it was blocked: stale_primary_design_guide_payload.

entries.description: Every candidate/apply path must preserve at least two top and two bottom longitudinal bars; one-bar top or bottom arrangements are invalid across all families.
entries.scope: shared candidate evaluation / Design Guide apply guard
entries.input_state: Candidate or update produces one top or one bottom longitudinal bar.
entries.expected_card_state: No family may publish a one-bar arrangement as an accepted recommendation.
entries.expected_cta_state: Apply is blocked when the resulting top or bottom longitudinal bar count is below 2.
entries.source: Live app model screenshot showing one bottom bar.

entries.description: Bending overdesign one-click Apply must not settle back to a second ACTION card when exact-stop or same-click target-band cleanup should own the terminal state.
entries.input_state: Bending overdesign cleanup publishes an executable Apply CTA, applies it, then the post-Apply card remains ACTION instead of terminal PASS/accepted proof.
entries.expected_card_state: Green accepted/terminal Design Guide card, or explicit no-action exact blocker proof with no second actionable CTA.
entries.expected_cta_state: No second Apply CTA after the selected one-click cleanup is applied unless the family contract explicitly proves multi-step cleanup is required.
entries.expected_target_or_blocker: Target band reached, same-click cleanup folded to target band, or exact exhaustive no-further-cleanup proof.

entries.description: Combined overdesign one-click Apply must not settle back to a second ACTION card when combined cleanup or exact-stop proof should own the terminal state.
entries.input_state: Combined overdesign cleanup publishes an executable Apply CTA, applies it, then the post-Apply card remains ACTION instead of terminal PASS/accepted proof.
entries.expected_card_state: Green accepted/terminal Design Guide card, or explicit no-action exact blocker proof with no second actionable CTA.
entries.expected_cta_state: No second Apply CTA after the selected one-click cleanup is applied unless the family contract explicitly proves multi-step cleanup is required.
entries.expected_target_or_blocker: Target band reached, same-click cleanup folded to target band, or exact exhaustive no-further-cleanup proof.
